test_get_cache_entry_success: test that get_cache_entry_from_step returns a cache entry with HTTP 200 OK status
test_get_cache_entry_error: test that get_cache_entry_from_step returns a cache entry with HTTP 500 internal server error status
test_get_cache_entry_no_cache: test that get_cache_entry_from_step raises ResponseNotReadyError when no cache entry exists for the dataset
test_get_cache_entry_disabled_viewer: test that get_cache_entry_from_step raises NotSupportedDisabledViewerError when the dataset viewer is disabled
test_get_cache_entry_blocked: test that get_cache_entry_from_step raises DatasetInBlockListError when the dataset is in the blocked list
